resources.string: Lets Miss Minutes inspect the visible app screen and, only when you give a command, tap accessible controls and enter text. Screen content may be sent to your configured AI provider. It does not passively collect screen content.

Select Miss Minutes as your Android Assistant. Android can then keep its lightweight voice-interaction service available. This does not guarantee a wake phrase on every phone: hardware hotword support is device-dependent. Foreground screen content and screenshots remain disabled by default.
Miss Minutes is the selected system Assistant.

Android did not grant the Assistant role. No system setting was changed.
The system Assistant session is active. Screen content is not shared unless you explicitly enable that feature.
